name: Match 3 Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Match Mania 3 is a fun and cute matching game that you can play from any device. Play on your computer or your mobile device, this game was made for them all. Pick up this casual game with colorful and bold blocks decorated with shapes like stars, diamonds, and pentagons. The cute yet simple animation makes for a fun matching game to play. Your objective is to create rows or columns of 3 or more blocks of the same color. Every game is timed so match the blocks quickly! Once you do a match, the blocks will disappear and you will get new blocks. For every game, your main competition should be yourself. Challenge yourself to beat your best score every time! As you become a better player, you will also rise up the leaderboards beating out all the other competition. What are you waiting for? Pick up this cute matching game and start playing!
